Laura / Vivek —

Following our Q2 review I want to surface some consistent gaps I've observed with Priya's work on the Search relevance project and propose a short, focused coaching cadence before we consider formal HR steps. This is confidential between leadership and HR for now. Key points:

- Missed delivery commitments on two sprints (delays primarily related to QA handoff and addressing post-merge bugs).
- Rework rate on review comments is higher than team average (examples attached in the CSV).
- Communication: several ambiguous status updates that required follow-up to unblock partners.

My ask: create a 60-day, evidence-driven coaching plan with weekly 1:1s and clear, measurable checkpoints (not subjective feedback). I attached a compact performance_log_q2.csv that pulls together dates and issue links. Can we align on metrics and a single escalation threshold (e.g., failure to meet >2 of 4 checkpoints)?

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura to own the coaching plan doc (bullet goals + measurement) and copy David for HR oversight.
2) Weekly 30-min 1:1s (Alex + Priya), with Laura joining every other week for calibration.
3) Shared spreadsheet for outcomes and artifacts; export to HR folder.

I can draft the first coaching template if you want — aim to have the plan in place by next Wednesday (6/23).

Thanks,
Alex

Laura / Vivek / David —

Attached: 1on1-notes-20270615.pdf (compact plan + examples). TL;DR of the plan below — I kept it to the three prioritized outcomes we discussed so it's evidence-driven and timeboxed.

Goals (60-day):
- Delivery cadence: Complete assigned sprint scope on time for next two sprints (measured by sprint reports and release notes).
- PR quality: Reduce PR rework rate to <= 15% (baseline in CSV).
- Communication: Respond to blocking messages during working hours within 4 hours and post daily standup updates in the team channel.

Cadence & Evidence:
- Weekly 30-min 1:1s (Alex + Priya) — agenda includes summarizing artifacts (PR links, tickets closed, blocker log).
- Biweekly calibration with Laura (every other week).
- Shared tracking sheet: each week we log: sprint scope delivered (Y/N), PR rework %, missed deadlines (with root cause), examples of ambiguous status messages.
- Checkpoints at day 14, day 30, and day 60. Failure to meet >=2 checkpoints moves to HR-managed next steps.

Support & Interventions:
- Short paired reviews on complex PRs for two weeks to reduce rework costs.
- Invitation to office hours with an engineering mentor (Vivek agreed to provide 1x pairing session/week).

Next steps: Laura to confirm wording and whether HR wants to add formal documentation details. I will hold off on sharing this with Priya until we align on language.

Attachments: 1on1-notes-20270615.pdf (plan + examples)
